svg.title: Cartyators architecture — private project
svg.desc: Application flow through Caddy to Next.js and Spring Boot, with PostgreSQL and mobile.de integration. The expanded AI view shows an independent stdio MCP adapter and opt-in LangChain4j backend using a shared business contract.

g.text: Deployment: Caddy, Next.js, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL on Docker Swarm / Hetzner
One business contract. Two ways to use it.
Inside the same Spring Boot process
AI paths use the authenticated business API and existing permissions. The MCP adapter and LangChain4j operate independently.
Current local implementations; not a claim of a combined production release. Source code remains private.
